issues.issue: Is G.J.'s appeal moot after she was admitted as a refugee?
issues.result_quote: She has since been admitted as a refugee to Canada, rendering her appeal in this case moot.

issues.issue: Which standard of review applies to the Board's interpretation of s. 37(1)(b)?
issues.result_quote: We find it unnecessary to resolve this issue on these appeals.

issues.issue: What conduct makes a person inadmissible for people smuggling under s. 37(1)(b)?
issues.applicant_position: People smuggling requires a financial or other material benefit tied to transnational organized crime; mutual aid is excluded.
issues.respondent_position: Any assistance to undocumented migrants is people smuggling; no financial benefit requirement is needed.
issues.result_quote: applies only to people who act to further illegal entry of asylum-seekers in order to obtain, directly or indirectly, a financial or other material benefit

issues.issue: May B306 raise the defences of duress and necessity?
issues.applicant_position: B306 should be able to raise duress and necessity if he falls within s. 37(1)(b).
issues.respondent_position: Ministers conceded the defences are available in principle.
issues.result_quote: I prefer not to decide the issue, in the absence of full argument on how these defences would fit into the scheme

issues.issue: Does s. 37(1)(b) violate s. 7 of the Charter through overbreadth?
issues.applicant_position: Section 37(1)(b) is overbroad, catching mutual aiders and humanitarian workers, contrary to s. 7.
issues.result_quote: I find it unnecessary to consider the appellants’ constitutional challenge.
